coding_hook_entities_incarnation_key.name: coding_hook_entities_incarnation_key
coding_hook_entities_incarnation_key.value: "coding_hook_entities"."incarnation_key" IS NULL OR (length("coding_hook_entities"."incarnation_key") = 64 AND "coding_hook_entities"."incarnation_key" NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*')

coding_hook_entities_ordinal_incarnation.name: coding_hook_entities_ordinal_incarnation
coding_hook_entities_ordinal_incarnation.value: ("coding_hook_entities"."source_offset" IS NULL AND "coding_hook_entities"."incarnation_key" IS NULL) OR ("coding_hook_entities"."source_offset" IS NOT NULL AND "coding_hook_entities"."incarnation_key" IS NOT NULL)

coding_hook_installations_workspace.name: coding_hook_installations_workspace
coding_hook_installations_workspace.value: "coding_hook_installations"."workspace" IS NULL OR length(CAST("coding_hook_installations"."workspace" AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096

coding_hook_installations_scope_workspac.name: coding_hook_installations_scope_workspace
coding_hook_installations_scope_workspac.value: ("coding_hook_installations"."scope" = 'global' AND "coding_hook_installations"."workspace" IS NULL) OR ("coding_hook_installations"."scope" = 'local' AND "coding_hook_installations"."workspace" IS NOT NULL)

coding_hook_sessions_incarnation_key.name: coding_hook_sessions_incarnation_key
coding_hook_sessions_incarnation_key.value: "coding_hook_sessions"."incarnation_key" IS NULL OR (length("coding_hook_sessions"."incarnation_key") = 64 AND "coding_hook_sessions"."incarnation_key" NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*')

coding_hook_sessions_prefix_sha256.name: coding_hook_sessions_prefix_sha256
coding_hook_sessions_prefix_sha256.value: "coding_hook_sessions"."prefix_sha256" IS NULL OR (length("coding_hook_sessions"."prefix_sha256") = 64 AND "coding_hook_sessions"."prefix_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*')

coding_hook_sessions_prefix_integrity.name: coding_hook_sessions_prefix_integrity
coding_hook_sessions_prefix_integrity.value: ("coding_hook_sessions"."prefix_bytes" = 0 AND "coding_hook_sessions"."prefix_sha256" IS NULL) OR ("coding_hook_sessions"."prefix_bytes" > 0 AND "coding_hook_sessions"."prefix_sha256" IS NOT NULL)

coding_hook_sessions_suppressed_tombston.name: coding_hook_sessions_suppressed_tombstone
coding_hook_sessions_suppressed_tombston.value: "coding_hook_sessions"."state" <> 'suppressed' OR ("coding_hook_sessions"."incarnation_key" IS NULL AND "coding_hook_sessions"."prefix_sha256" IS NULL AND "coding_hook_sessions"."prefix_bytes" = 0 AND "coding_hook_sessions"."source_cursor" = 0 AND "coding_hook_sessions"."observed_file_bytes" = 0 AND length(CAST("coding_hook_sessions"."data" AS BLOB)) <= 1024)

review_queue_items_approval.name: review_queue_items_approval
review_queue_items_approval.value: ("review_queue_items"."state" = 'draft' AND "review_queue_items"."approved_hash" IS NULL AND "review_queue_items"."approved_at" IS NULL AND "review_queue_items"."review_source" IS NULL) OR ("review_queue_items"."state" IN ('approved','promoted') AND "review_queue_items"."approved_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "review_queue_items"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "review_queue_items"."review_source" = 'localOperator')

review_queue_items_promotion.name: review_queue_items_promotion
review_queue_items_promotion.value: ("review_queue_items"."state" != 'promoted' AND "review_queue_items"."promoted_dataset_id" IS NULL AND "review_queue_items"."promoted_dataset_version" IS NULL AND "review_queue_items"."promoted_case_id" IS NULL) OR ("review_queue_items"."state" = 'promoted' AND "review_queue_items"."promoted_dataset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "review_queue_items"."promoted_dataset_version" IS NOT NULL AND "review_queue_items"."promoted_case_id" IS NOT NULL)

runs_with_hints.name: runs_with_hints
runs_with_hints.definition:
SELECT
    r.*,
    (SELECT s.model FROM spans s WHERE s.run_id = r.id AND s.model IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS model,
    (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0
                  AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('OK','ERROR') THEN 1 END)
                 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     FROM spans s WHERE s.run_id = r.id AND s.parent_span_id IS NULL) AS finished,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spans s WHERE s.run_id = r.id) AS span_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM live_events e WHERE e.trace_id = r.id) AS live_event_count,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(LENGTH(COALESCE(s.input_payload, '')) + LENGTH(COALESCE(s.output_payload, ''))), 0)
     FROM spans s WHERE s.run_id = r.id) AS payload_total_chars
  FROM runs r
